mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_links (id, source_id, target_id, relation_type, weight, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sourceId}, #{targetId}, #{relationType}, #{weight}, clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.source_id, l.target_id, l.relation_type, l.weight, m.title as target_title, m.type as target_type FROM memory_links l LEFT JOIN memories m ON l.target_id = m.id WHERE l.source_id = #{sourceId}

SELECT l.id, l.source_id, l.target_id, l.relation_type, s.title as source_title, s.type as source_type, s.status as source_status, t.title as target_title, t.type as target_type, t.status as target_status FROM memory_links l LEFT JOIN memories s ON l.source_id = s.id LEFT JOIN memories t ON l.target_id = t.id WHERE l.source_id = #{memoryId} OR l.target_id = #{memoryId}
SELECT id, title, type, status, importance FROM memories WHERE status != 'archived' ORDER BY importance DESC LIMIT #{limit}
